service: three-burst actual normal Backend::submit_embed A/B/C=A; all three Submission::Deferred
CompletionThread is independent of the harness caller
complete C then B then A with exact baseline entry identity and F32 words
drop A while B handle held, complete B, retry A
core: third C=A submitted from an owned std worker thread; it must block on the common slot pool while both A and B are held
the receiver must not yield or await while both are held; poll the worker result for 50ms and require timeout
complete B, receive C with a bounded 5s receive, join the worker, require C Deferred, then complete C and A with exact baseline F32 words
never issue the third held submit synchronously on the caller that holds both results
drop A while B held; submit C=A AFTER dropping A and BEFORE completing B; require C Deferred; complete C/B exact baseline
T7 held then T9 different geometry must be Deferred under the two-slot/two-independent-key budget; complete T9 then A; retry T9 exact; no healthy Busy/Overloaded expected
invalid IDs/positions/CU/selection/media/compact/empty actual typed rejection, including no-selection variants
adapter drop with A/B Deferred held then B completes
lifecycle_requirements.thread_control_helper: the actual core lifecycle uses the same owned-thread blocking/wakeup helper covered by a pure CPU unit test; source only, no execution in this update
lifecycle_requirements.result_budget: pure CPU actual ResultPool tests cover retain/exhausted Overloaded/drop/recover; no fake fault injection
lifecycle_requirements.isolation: one engine per process; controller runs separate fresh processes; never two 72GB engines
lifecycle_requirements.timeout_process_groups: control/controller.py owns external timeout and killpg; controller/comparator unchanged
lifecycle_requirements.fatal_scope: No public poison API and no unsafe GPU fault injection; actual unexpected BackendError is reported typed by stage; CPU envelope test is explicitly not runtime failed-fence qualification; product source CPU failed-fence proof remains separate
lifecycle_requirements.unbound_freeze: product source is unsealed and the product freeze sha256 is explicitly UNBOUND until Codex binds the final value before any build

control.comparator_policy: exact F32 bits, zero tolerance, exact index/kind/shape/error variant
